A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same HeadHunter and SoftPAG research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–I support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SD3 and FLUX.1-Dev generation experiments, quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–2, and extensive qualitative and sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and appendices, including quantitative comparisons and generated-image analyses.

M1.justification: HeadHunter retains the same generation, scoring and top-k expansion procedure, and SoftPAG retains the same attention-map interpolation. Renaming search iterations as rounds does not change the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions retain MS-COCO general-quality evaluation, SD3 and FLUX.1-Dev style experiments, unseen-content evaluation and null-prompt scenarios. No dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the unguided baseline, CFG at scales 3.0 and 6.0, and combined CFG–HeadHunter comparison. Table 2 retains uniform-matrix, query-mean and identity-matrix perturbations; the layer-level comparisons also remain.

E3.justification: The reported prompt counts, search budgets, sampling steps, guidance scales and metrics remain unchanged. Appendix D.1 newly specifies u = 0.25; v1 gives no explicit corresponding value there, so this is assessed as implementation disclosure under D1, without establishing a changed experiment.

E4.justification: The head-count and interpolation sweeps, layer-distribution analysis, individually weak-head case studies, prompt-dependence tests and appendix compositional analyses are retained. Figure relocation and relabeling do not add analyses.

E5.justification: Averaging over prompt–seed pairs and the seed information in Tables 3–4 remain unchanged. Neither version adds repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 retain their numerical values; for example, HeadHunter (3.0) retains PickScore 20.70 and AES 5.92 in Table 1. Matched plots and qualitative examples retain their results despite presentation and image-resolution changes.

T1.justification: The equations, interpolation definitions and computational-cost expression retain their mathematical content. Renaming head outputs, search rounds and temperature variables changes notation only; no substantive derivation or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: interpretable and compositional head-level guidance, objective-driven HeadHunter selection, and continuous perturbation control through SoftPAG.

C2.justification: Section 4.1.1 adds an explanation linking one-round success to structural realism and discusses using additional computation to discover further quality-enhancing heads. The existing computational limitations and dependence of some styles on explicit prompts remain.

D1.justification: Appendix D.1 newly specifies u = 0.25 for general-quality experiments. v3 also supplies the full style prompt for Figure 10(b) and adds a project-page link to the abstract; these improve documentation without establishing newly available code or rerun experiments.

R1.justification: The reference list and Appendix A related-work discussion are unchanged. The added PAG citation in Figure 1 refers to an already cited work and does not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: Limited rewrites clarify layer-level versus head-level guidance and the search-round rationale. Terminology and notation are standardized, author information is corrected, and the overall section hierarchy remains intact.

P2.justification: Algorithm 1 and several figures are repositioned, Figure 15 is redrawn, and round/temperature labels and some captions are revised. Figure 11 uses higher-resolution images, while the figure and table inventory remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves reproducibility and readability by documenting u = 0.25 in Appendix D.1, supplying Figure 10(b)'s style prompt, and clarifying explanations and figure placement. The scientific method and experimental evidence remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to documentation and presentation.
